Title: [LSJ] One more time, about Dark Influences

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Sorry, I know this was probably answered somewhere official before, but I am
still confused.

Situation:
Methuselah A plays Govern the Unaligned.
Methuselah B plays Dark Influences to cancel the Govern and puts DarkI into
play.

Which of the following statements is true about Dark Influences, at some point
later in the game?

1) *Any* Methuselah plays Scouting Mission. *Any* other Methuselah plays
Direct Intervention. The Direct Intervention is canceled, and the Dark
Influences is burned.

2) Methuselah B plays Scouting Mission. Any other Methuselah plays Direct
Intervention. The Scouting Mission is canceled, and the Dark Influences
stays in play.

Thank you.

Messages.Author: malcol...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
I have a clarifaction to ask:

> Botched Move (if successful)

Botched Move cancels a card... maybe. But it would seem that dark
influences couldn't cancel it _if successful_ ... since at that point
Botched move is already in the middle of resolving. You couldn't DI a
botched move _after_ you saw it was successful, and it would seem it
wouldn't work that way for Dark Influences effect either.

So the question is: does Botched move trigger Dark influences at all?
And if so, is it indeed immediately?
